function.name: get_stickers
function.description: Get list of available stickers. You can use sticker: [sticker:name] (max 1 sticker for message)

function.name: get_news
function.description: Get latest news from MineBridge news feed

limit.description: Number of news items to fetch (max: 20)

function.name: web_search
function.description: Search the web for current information, news, or any topic. Use this when you need up-to-date information or facts not in your knowledge base.

max_results.description: Maximum number of results to return (max: 10)

function.name: add_sticker
function.description: Add a new sticker to the database. Analyze the sticker's visual content and generate a brief Russian description (2-4 words) of what is depicted or the emotion conveyed. Use this when user asks to add/save/remember a sticker.

description.description: Brief Russian description of the sticker (2-4 words), e.g. 'грустный кот', 'пепе смеется', 'лайк'

message_id.description: Telegram message ID of the sticker to add

function.name: rename_sticker
function.description: Rename an existing sticker in the database. Use this when the user asks to rename or change the name of a sticker.

old_name.description: Current name of the sticker to rename (optional if message_id is provided)

new_name.description: New name for the sticker - a brief Russian description (2-4 words)

message_id.description: Telegram message ID of the sticker (optional if old_name is not provided)

function.name: set_guess
function.description: Set the guessed object for the 'Who am I?' game. Use this ONCE at the start of the game to save what you've chosen. The object will be saved and you'll see it in future messages.

object.description: The Minecraft object you've chosen (mob, item, creature, GUI interface, event like rain, etc.) in Russian

function.name: clear_guess
function.description: Clear the guessed object and end the 'Who am I?' game. Use this when the user has correctly guessed the object or wants to stop the game.

function.name: save_memory
function.description: Save important information to memory in neutral tone. IMPORTANT: Decide between 'chat' (local memes, jokes, chat-specific events) or 'user' (global info: city, education, health, preferences). Save in neutral, factual tone without mentioning who said or asked. Examples: CHAT: 'JustVayk - абоба' (local meme), USER: 'Живёт в Москве' (global info about person). Auto memory updates (💡 Память обновлена:), not need to write about new memory.

scope.description: Memory type: 'chat' for local memes/jokes/chat events, 'user' for global personal info (city, education, health, preferences)

content.description: What to remember in NEUTRAL TONE. Don't include source ('сообщил', 'попросил', 'из новостей'). Just the fact. Examples: 'JustVayk - абоба' (not 'JustCheburek сказал что...'), '6 февраля 2026 в MineBridge королевская битва' (not 'согласно новостям...')

function.name: update_memory
function.description: Update existing memory record. Use when user wants to edit or correct previously saved information.

memory_id.description: ID of memory to update (can be partial, e.g., first 8 characters)

content.description: New content (optional, leave empty to keep current)

tags.description: New tags (optional, leave empty to keep current)

function.name: delete_memory
function.description: Delete a memory record. Used when information is outdated or user asks to forget something.

search_query.description: Search query to find the record to delete

scope.description: Where to search: 'chat' or 'user' memory (optional, searches in current chat by default)
